page.layout: One page of running text, with one marginal note in the right margin beside the fifth to eighth lines of the paragraph. The page is continued in part 2.; One column of running text, set in italic, filling the page from top to bottom. No margin notes. Below the text, at the foot of the column, a gathering signature.

main_text.p: rationem, ad ipsam veritatem per se evidentem: quam nec respicit, neq; attingit per aliquod medium; sed so-lùm indiget notitiâ terminorum: quam item habet per species terminorum, ex quibus principia ipsa com-ponuntur. Ista autem species producuntur ab intel-Species in-telligibiles producun-tur ab intel-lectu agen-te. lectu agente, & imprimuntur intellectui passibili, mediis speciebus sensibilibus objectorum, qua vocari phantasmata supra non semel indicatum est. Operatio porrò sensuum, & ejusdem intellectus agentis, per quam efficiuntur species, naturalis est, & sine habitu efficitur. Informatus autem intellectus patiens per has species principiorum, & intellecta per eas significatione terminorum, sine ulla arte vel indu- striâ;sine ullo medio,vel discursu assentitur princi-piis:&per talem assensum,generatur habitus prin-cipiorum: qui posteà intenditur & perficitur per fre-quentem repetitionem ejusdem assensus. Et ideò, tàm ex parte specierum,naturaliter productarum, quàm ex parte assensus principiorum,dicitur habitus iste na-turalis: quamvis sit liber ( id est,non coactus ) assen-sus, & ex consequenti, liberè producatur habitus per eum. Et tandem,quia assensus principiorum, & ha-bitus ipse,producuntur sine medio,sine discursu ,sine arte,solùm per naturale lumen ejusdem intellectus: ideò non est nomen aliud ei inditum,sed nomine ejus-dem intellectus significatur, dum dicimus,esse intelle-ctum principiorum. Hæc autem non habent alii ha-bitus intellectuales, ut habitus scientia. Is enim præ-ter operationem intellectus agentis,præter species con-clufionis, quas imprimit intellectui patienti,præ-requirit artem, per quam disponantur principia: præ-requirit assensum eorum,tanquam medium formale,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "neq;" (line 2) is printed with a special abbreviation mark that I have read as neq; with [?] not added because the form is clear enough, but it may be neque. "lùm" (line 3) carries a grave accent as printed. "ponuntur." (line 5) is cut at the left edge of the scan and may be misread at its first letters. Parts of the running head and the marginal note are set in small type and read with some uncertainty at the edges. The last line is broken at a hyphen and continues on the next part of the page. The signature mark after "R" is read as a 5 (possibly a long-s form); uncertain. No page number or running head is printed on this part.
